scope: Independent analytical CPU recomputation; no archived code or SD1.5 networks executed
limitations: Recorded GPU alpha/sigma used after checking CPU scheduler within relative tolerance 1e-7: sqrt FP32 CPU/CUDA can differ by one ulp. Direct CPU roots initially produced a 1.19e-7 gradient norm discrepancy at LiDAR_1 t341, resolved by using the recorded coefficient, without loosening the gradient comparison.
No independent recomputation of U-Net predictions or VAE/reward model; only saved states and bank used.
Ideal DDIM step delta ignores fp16 conversion and arithmetic; it is a counterfactual at one fixed state, not distance to the full BASE trajectory.
An ESS near one concerns bank weights, not measured diversity across independently generated output images.
